description: Unit tests for the ImmutableAcknowledgement class, focusing on immutability, equality, JSON serialization, and behavior based on status codes within the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.acks.base package.

classes.name: ImmutableAcknowledgementTest
classes.description: Test class for ImmutableAcknowledgement, verifying behaviors such as immutability, JSON serialization, correctness of equals/hashCode, and logic related to status codes.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test setup before each test, particularly setting up DittoHeaders with a unique correlation ID.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that ImmutableAcknowledgement instances are immutable and that related object types used within are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies equals and hashCode implementations using EqualsVerifier, including prefab values for EntityIdWithType.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullAcknowledgementLabel
methods.description: Ensures that passing null as acknowledgment label throws NullPointerException with the correct message.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullEntityId
methods.description: Ensures that passing null as entity ID throws NullPointerException with the correct message.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullStatusCode
methods.description: Ensures that passing null as status code throws NullPointerException with the correct message.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullDittoHeaders
methods.description: Ensures that passing null as DittoHeaders throws NullPointerException with the correct message.

methods.name: toJsonWithoutEntityReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks the JSON output of an ImmutableAcknowledgement instance without a payload entity.

methods.name: toJsonWithEntityReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks the JSON output including a payload entity.

methods.name: getLabelReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that getLabel() returns the correct acknowledgment label.

methods.name: getEntityIdReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that getEntityId() returns the correct entity ID.

methods.name: acknowledgementWithStatusCodeNotFoundIsNotSuccess
methods.description: Tests that a NOT_FOUND status code results in isSuccess() being false.

methods.name: acknowledgementWithStatusCodeOkIsSuccess
methods.description: Tests that an OK status code results in isSuccess() being true.

methods.name: liveResponseAcknowledgementWithNonTimeoutIsSuccess
methods.description: Checks that a live response with a non-timeout status code is successful.

methods.name: liveResponseAcknowledgementWithTimeoutIsFailed
methods.description: Checks that a live response with a timeout status code is not successful.

methods.name: acknowledgementWithStatusCodeOkIsNotTimeout
methods.description: Verifies that an OK status code results in isTimeout() being false.

methods.name: acknowledgementWithStatusCodeRequestTimeoutIsTimeout
methods.description: Verifies that a REQUEST_TIMEOUT status code results in isTimeout() being true.

methods.name: getStatusCodeReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that getStatusCode() returns the correct StatusCode.

methods.name: getExistingEntity
methods.description: Checks that getEntity() returns the payload when present.

methods.name: getMissingEntity
methods.description: Checks that getEntity() returns empty when no payload is set.

methods.name: getDittoHeadersReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that getDittoHeaders() returns the correct headers object.

methods.name: responseRequiredIsSetToFalse
methods.description: Verifies that responseRequired is false on the headers used in test setup.

methods.name: setDittoHeadersWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that setting new DittoHeaders results in a new acknowledgement with the updated headers and preserved other properties.

methods.name: getEntityTypeReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that getEntityType() returns the correct entity type string.

methods.name: getTypeReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that getType() returns the expected string based on entity type.
